items.translation: 聚合多个 `Alias` 注解的容器注解。

items.translation: 基于Elasticsearch 参考文档中的值。

items.source: Values for the dynamic mapping parameter.
items.translation: dynamic 映射参数的值。

items.source: Identifies an alias for the index.
items.translation: 识别索引的别名。

items.source: Alias for a @Query annotation with the count parameter set to true.
items.translation: @Query 注解的别名，其 count 参数设置为 true。

items.source: Identifies a domain object to be persisted to Elasticsearch.
items.translation: 确定要持久化到 Elasticsearch 的域对象。

items.source:
Note: the enum value FORCE, which was introduced in 4.4 has been removed
again by Elasticsearch.
items.translation: 注意：Elasticsearch 再次移除了在 4.4 版本中引入的枚举值 FORCE。

items.source: Elasticsearch dynamic templates mapping.
items.translation: Elasticsearch 动态模板映射。

items.source: Query used to limit documents.
items.translation: 用于限制文档数量的查询。

items.source:
Annotation to mark a String property of an entity to be filled with the name of the index where the entity was stored
after it is indexed into Elasticsearch.
items.translation: 用于标记实体字符串属性，以便在将其实体索引到 Elasticsearch 后，填入该实体所存储的索引名称。

items.source: Elasticsearch Mapping
items.translation: Elasticsearch 映射

items.source: Defines a field alias in the index mapping.
items.translation: 在索引映射中定义字段别名。

items.source: Annotation to enable custom routing values for an entity.
items.translation: 用于为实体启用自定义路由值的注解。

items.source: Marks a property to be populated with the result of a scripted field retrieved from an Elasticsearch response.
items.translation: 将属性标记为需要填充从 Elasticsearch 响应中检索的脚本字段的结果。

items.source: Annotation to mark a repository method as a search template method.
items.translation: 用于标记存储库方法为搜索模板方法的注解。

items.source: Elasticsearch Setting
items.translation: Elasticsearch 设置

items.source:
This annotation can be placed on repository methods to define the properties that should be requested from
Elasticsearch when the method is run.
items.translation: 此注解可应用于存储库方法，以定义在运行该方法时从 Elasticsearch 请求的属性。

items.source:
Annotation to put on a property of an entity to define a value converter which can convert the property to a type
that Elasticsearch understands and back.
items.translation: 在实体属性上添加的注解，用于定义一个值转换器，该转换器可将属性转换为 Elasticsearch 可识别的类型，并支持反向转换。

items.source: Annotation to mark a property that will be written to Elasticsearch, but not set when reading from Elasticsearch.
items.translation: 用于标记将写入 Elasticsearch 但在从 Elasticsearch 读取时不会设置的属性的注解。

items.source: Defines if type hints should be written.
items.translation: 定义是否应编写类型提示。
